candidate_relations.reason: The chronic unilateral hyperkeratotic papules and biopsy showing compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and a bandlike superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate support HLP. Necrobiosis lipoidica typically presents as atrophic yellow-brown plaques with histologic collagen necrobiosis and granulomatous inflammation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different diabetes-associated cutaneous disorder; does not identify unilateral hyperkeratosis lenticularis perstans.
